OSID="$(. /etc/os-release && echo "$ID")"
if [ ! "$OSID" = "debian" ] && [ ! -f /etc/centos-release ] && [ ! -f /etc/rocky-release ] && [ ! -f /etc/redhat-release ] && ! grep -qi cos /etc/os-release ; then
  echo '[Batch Disk Mount] Warning: this is not a tested operating system, PD mounting may fail.'
fi

yes | /sbin/mkfs.ext4 -m 0 -E lazy_itable_init=0,lazy_journal_init=0,discard /dev/disk/by-id/google-local-disk
UUID_INFO=$(sudo blkid /dev/disk/by-id/google-local-disk)

NEW_DIR=false
if [ ! -d /mnt/disks/cromwell_root ]; then
  mkdir -p /mnt/disks/cromwell_root
  NEW_DIR=true
fi
umount /mnt/disks/cromwell_root
if ! mount -l | grep -q "$DISK_ID on /mnt/disks/cromwell_root"; then
  mount -o discard,defaults UUID=$UUID /mnt/disks/cromwell_root
else
  echo "[Batch Disk Mount] local-disk (DISK_ID: $DISK_ID, UUID: $UUID) is already mounted on /mnt/disks/cromwell_root"
fi
MOUNT_CONFIG=$(mount -l | grep "$DISK_ID on /mnt/disks/cromwell_root")
if $NEW_DIR && echo "$MOUNT_CONFIG" | grep -q "rw" ; then
  chmod 777 /mnt/disks/cromwell_root
fi
